environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on EC2 behind CloudFront distribution (ID: E2XYZABC123) with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy type 'always-sign'. The origin is configured with a custom header gate: the ALB listener rule requires header 'X-Origin-Verify' to match a rotating secret (AWS Secrets Manager, rotated every 4h via Lambda). CloudFront behaviors have Viewer Protocol Policy 'https-only' and all requests require CloudFront signed URLs (Trusted Key Group 'kg-prod-2024' with RSA-2048 key pair, policy restricts to source IP CIDR and 30-second expiry). CloudFront has cache behaviors with TTL min=1s, default=5s, max=30s for POST passthrough disabled — POST requests to /auth/* use CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad (CachingDisabled) but are subject to Origin Request Policy that normalizes timing by buffering responses. The security group on the ALB restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. Direct origin access returns 403 from ALB rule priority 1 (fixed-response action).

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 c5.large, ALB, CloudFront with OAC
